hold_text: Adds automation/jobs/1c-live-alarms-state-01.job, which vm-driver.yml turns into bash executed over SSH on the LIVE money-handling VM. The job's payload is read-only by construction (GET /api/diag/* plus an allowlisted /proc/<MainPID>/environ read and systemctl is-active; nothing written, no trade-mutating command). Its commit message states it is operator-approved -- that is the AUTHOR SESSION'S claim, and the manager has not seen the approval itself, so it is recorded as a claim and not banked as one. Needs one operator OK naming this job file before it lands.
why: Docs-only when opened; a VM-executing job file was added to the branch afterwards, which takes it off the Tier-1 self-land surface. Re-declared rather than narrowed, because splitting the job out would separate it from the disposition that explains why it exists.
